# PanePilot v0.8.3

PanePilot 0.8.3 fixes sluggish switching between LaTeX projects and capabilities
while preserving more live workspace state.

## Improvements and fixes

- Keep LaTeX Manuscript, an opened PDF, and the writing-chat margin mounted while
  switching capabilities. Saved and unsaved source models restore immediately,
  ordinary revisits avoid a manuscript rescan, and asynchronous local/SSH reads keep
  the interface responsive.
- Switch projects and terminals with targeted updates instead of reloading the full
  project collection. Each pane keeps up to four recently used terminal surfaces
  warm and loads saved replay output only when that surface first attaches.
- Share proof comments between local and SSH PanePilot clients through the project’s
  versioned `.panepilot/latex-comments.json` file. Existing client-local comments
  migrate only when the shared file is absent.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
